question: 'Huli Vesha' is a popular folk dance in the coastal region of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Huli Vesha is a dance form unique to coastal Karnataka.
 
• Huli Vesha is performed by local youth during the Navratri Festival.
 
• It is also known as Tiger faced dance.
 
• Huli Vesha is performed to pay tribute to Goddess Durga, whose official animal is tiger.
